unit: actor_rate[fame] personal fame points; not display grade or protagonist reputation

fog.scope: approved all Fog Border encounter table 2026-10-24
fog.groupReward: maximum enemy tier once; not per-enemy sum

proposedInterpretations.quarterAccounting: Per-actor0..3 quarters; four repeat victories above80 settle1 point. No fractional loss.
proposedInterpretations.legacyRally: No per-person historic wins available. Preserve existing fame; recommend first newly recorded victory after update for new bonus.
proposedInterpretations.legacyCatfight: Do not infer by halving catfight_level or global result visits. Exact personal history unavailable. No unapproved rewrite.
proposedInterpretations.fogActor: Only the companion who actually won; no fame for a defeated companion after protagonist takeover.
proposedInterpretations.fogResult: Existing battle victory semantics, including routed opponents; no extra mandatory-kill requirement.

otherPending: Legacy first-win and catfight counter policy
